name: SMASH Things!
desc:
Welcome to SMASH Things! 

Smash as many things as you can. 

You get points for breaking stuff! 

Top the leaderboard as the best breaker of stuffs. 

Get coins by playing to get different hammers.

Have fun, thanks for playing! 

The game is still in beta so if you find any issues let us know.
